Y03.text:
Invite applications for the Merit‑cum‑Means Scholarship for first‑year undergraduate students in Vindhya state for 2026‑27.
Scholarship amount is Rs. 25,000 per annum for up to four years, plus a one‑time book allowance of Rs. 5,000 in the first year.
Eligibility: permanent resident of Vindhya, at least 75% marks in Class XII, family income ≤ Rs. 2,50,000, and not receiving any other government scholarship.
Application window: open 1 November 2026, last date 31 December 2026. Institutes must verify by 15 January 2027; selection list published 15 February 2027.
Required documents: Class XII mark sheet, income certificate, residence certificate, bank passbook first page, admission receipt.
Renewal criteria: student must pass all subjects and maintain ≥80% attendance each year.
False information leads to disqualification and recovery of paid amount.
Application window opens 1 November 2026.
Last date to submit application 31 December 2026.
Institutes must verify applications by 15 January 2027.
Selection list published 15 February 2027.
Register and apply online at www.vssb.example.gov.in.
Upload required documents.
Scholarship amount Rs. 25,000 per annum, book allowance Rs. 5,000 first year.
Eligibility: permanent resident, ≥75% Class XII marks, family income ≤ Rs. 2,50,000, no other government scholarship.

Y01.text:
Inform students and department heads about the schedule, fees, eligibility, and procedures for the End Semester Examinations of November-December 2026.
Examinations run from 24 November to 12 December 2026.
Detailed timetable will be posted on the university website by 5 November 2026.
Examination fee is Rs. 1,800 per semester for regular students; Rs. 350 per supplementary paper.
Fee payment must be online only; cash and demand drafts not accepted.
Hall tickets available from 18 November 2026; must be printed and carried with ID card.
Students must report 30 minutes before each exam; electronic devices prohibited.
Results will be declared in the second week of January 2027.
Last date for fee payment without fine: 7 November 2026.
Late fee accepted until 14 November 2026.
No payments after 14 November 2026.

Pay examination fee online before 7 November 2026 (or before 14 November with fine).
Apply for condonation if attendance between 65% and 75% and pay Rs. 1,000 fee.

Regular students pay Rs. 1,800 per semester; supplementary papers Rs. 350 each.
Attendance minimum 75% to appear; 65-75% can apply for condonation with Rs. 1,000 fee; below 65% not eligible.

Y02.text:
Invite applications for full‑time M.Tech programmes at Deccan Institute of Technology for 2027‑28.
Full‑time M.Tech programmes in Computer Science, Data Science, VLSI Design and Structural Engineering with a total intake of 180 seats.
Eligibility requires a B.E./B.Tech with 60% marks (6.5 CGPA) or 55%/6.0 CGPA for SC/ST/PwD; final‑year students can apply if they prove passing by 31 July 2027.
Application fee is Rs. 1,200 for General/OBC and Rs. 600 for SC/ST/PwD, non‑refundable and payable online at application submission.
GATE score above 500 exempts candidates from the entrance test and leads directly to an interview.
Counselling requires original mark sheets, degree certificate, photo ID, category certificate (if applicable) and two passport‑size photos.
Tuition fee is Rs. 95,000 per year, payable at admission.
Applications must be submitted online via the admissions portal; postal or e‑mail applications are not accepted.
Online applications open 2 January 2027.
Last date for online applications 15 February 2027.
DIT Entrance Test on 7 March 2027 in Hyderabad, Bengaluru and Chennai.
Entrance test results announced 25 March 2027.
Counselling and seat allotment 10–14 April 2027.
Submit online application with required fee by 15 February 2027.
Attend DIT Entrance Test on 7 March 2027 unless exempted by GATE score.
Attend personal interview as part of selection process.
Bring required documents to counselling between 10–14 April 2027.
Pay tuition fee of Rs. 95,000 per year at admission.
Application fee Rs. 1,200 for General/OBC, Rs. 600 for SC/ST/PwD; non‑refundable.
Eligibility: B.E./B.Tech with 60% marks (6.5 CGPA) or 55%/6.0 CGPA for SC/ST/PwD; final‑year students can apply if they prove passing by 31 July 2027.

Y05.text:
Announce a free Digital Literacy Training Programme for citizens of Vindhya.
Training runs 10 days, 2-hour sessions daily, held at Common Service Centres and public libraries.
Participants who complete training and pass final assessment receive a certificate.
No fee for the training.
Eligibility: residents aged 18-60, able to read in English, Hindi or regional language; preference to women, senior citizens, rural residents.
Registration open 1–20 December 2026; can register at Common Service Centre or online; bring identity and address proof.
First batches begin 5 January 2027.
Registration period: 1–20 December 2026.
First batches start: 5 January 2027.
Register between 1 and 20 December 2026 at a Common Service Centre or online, bringing identity and address proof.
No fee for training.
Eligibility: residents aged 18-60, able to read in English, Hindi or regional language; preference to women, senior citizens, rural residents.
